result.summary: The page is mostly clean. There is one clear content defect: a misspelling in the search bar placeholder. A possible minor styling inconsistency affects the favorite (heart) buttons. Clipped carousel and chip items and the card cut off at the bottom are intended behavior and are not reported.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries'. 'Restaurants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Change the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons look inconsistent. The button on the second (pizza) card has a visible dark circular backdrop. The button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card appears to have little or no visible backdrop against the dark image, so it looks different and may be harder to see on some images.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent circular background to every heart button so it is consistent and visible regardless of the card image.
